lessons.keep: Use a clear visual release from dense problem evidence to a simple final promise.
lessons.avoid: Avoid using threat headlines as proof of product protection.
lessons.open: Privacy behavior, security claims, source rights, actual motion and all audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Show one public wallet view beside the actual information visible after a private transfer.
For Tin, follow one draft permission problem to an approved publishing state with one highlighted setting.
